svg.title: The disc method: the region under y = √x revolved about the x-axis
svg.desc: Left: the region under y = √x from x = 0 to 4, shaded, with one thin vertical rectangle of width Δx whose height is √x. Right: the solid made by revolving that region about the x-axis, a rounded horn shape, drawn in 3D with the x-axis through its center. The rectangle sweeps out one thin disc, highlighted in blue, whose radius is the rectangle's height, r = √x. Each disc has volume π r² Δx, so V = the integral from 0 to 4 of π(√x)² dx = 8π.
svg.text: x-axis: it sweeps out a disc.
V = ∫ from 0 to 4 of π(√x)2 dx = 8π
